description: This file implements the DefaultOptionsFormatter class, which formats configuration options for display or logging within the Orleans framework. It serializes options properties, respecting attributes like Obsolete and Redact, and handles collections and dictionaries. It also includes a resolver class for getting formatters by name.

classes.name: DefaultOptionsFormatter<T>
classes.description: Formats options of type T by reflecting over properties, applying custom attributes, and converting them into string representations.

classes.name: DefaultOptionsFormatterResolver<T>
classes.description: Resolves formatter instances for options of type T based on a named options monitor.

methods.name: DefaultOptionsFormatter<T>.DefaultOptionsFormatter
methods.description: Constructor that initializes the formatter with options retrieved via IOptions<T>.

methods.name: DefaultOptionsFormatter<T>.DefaultOptionsFormatter
methods.description: Internal constructor to initialize with a specific name and options instance.

methods.name: DefaultOptionsFormatter<T>.Format
methods.description: Iterates over the properties of T and formats each property if it is formattable.

methods.name: DefaultOptionsFormatterResolver<T>.Resolve
methods.description: Resolves and returns a formatter instance for a given options name.
